interpretationPrinciple: Preserve only the independently frozen TCG Live section structure, background hierarchy, asset identities, responsive order, pre-translation typography, and CTA. Entry motion remains unresolved and cannot become an implementation or acceptance requirement.

visualIntent.summary: A product-world callout that crosses a red/gold V-shaped threshold into a pale-gray technical field. A five-layer product scene and a local black copy panel divide visual demonstration from explanation and action.
hierarchy: The red/gold V is a top seam embedded in the section background, not a solid-red section fill.
The pale-gray honeycomb field is the dominant section body.
The five independent assets form one product scene, with the laptop as the rear plane.
The black panel locally groups H2, body, and CTA.
The section ends with a hard cut into the pale-blue Pocket section.

layers.rule: Use the validated full-bleed TCG Live raster containing the red/gold top seam and pale-gray honeycomb body.
Desktop uses a translucent-black rectangular panel on the left; mobile uses an opaque-black full-width panel below the assets.
Preserve laptop rear plane, lower-left Pikachu, lower-right phone, and two avatars above as five independent transparent assets.
Centered H2, one paragraph, and one white CTA only; no kicker.
Use a hard transition to the following pale-blue section without a rounded outer shell.

responsiveMatrix.invariant: V seam, honeycomb field, asset scene, copy panel, and hard lower boundary remain within one section.
Mobile is a deliberate vertical recomposition, not a miniature desktop row.

responsiveMatrix.mobile390: 390px full width, approximately 314.195px in the translated settled geometry, opaque black, padding 30px.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: Rectangular local contrast field containing H2, paragraph, and CTA only.

responsiveMatrix.desktop1440: 778x538 group with laptop 657x387.633 as rear plane.
responsiveMatrix.mobile390: 374x258.625 group with the same overlap identities preserved.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: Five independent transparent source assets retain their semantic layer roles.
One English H2; no kicker; wrapping is fluid and cannot be inferred from translated pixels.

responsiveMatrix.mobile390: PT Sans 400, 18/28.8; expected English height comes from pre-translation computed evidence.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: One paragraph between H2 and CTA.
One white Learn More action; do not infer additional CTA states from unavailable evidence.

mustPreserve: laptop as the large rear plane
avatar-1 and avatar-2 floating above the laptop
allowedVariation: Scale the complete asset group to fit the observed viewport relationship while preserving overlaps.
Allow original English copy to wrap naturally within the recorded content width.
mustNotReplace: Do not flatten the five assets into a screenshot or composite crop.
Do not substitute unrelated official assets.
Do not turn the V seam into a solid-red section.
Do not retain desktop order at 390px.
Do not add a kicker or rounded outer shell.

interactionRecipes.observed: Source classes and initial computed values suggest pop/slide behavior, but no stable same-section before/mid/settled visual sequence was obtained.
interactionRecipes.restriction: Do not prescribe exact transforms, timing, delay order, choreography, trigger behavior, or visual acceptance frames. Omit motion or treat it only as an explicitly non-source-faithful optional experiment pending new Evidence.

sectionLocalRules: translucent desktop and opaque mobile black copy panel
Kanit H2 and PT Sans body/CTA roles
notGlobalTokens: Red is not a global page background, primary action, or active-state color.
Gold is not a global interaction token.
Black panel styling is not a global section, card, modal, or host surface.
Honeycomb is not a global page texture.
The typography roles do not establish unrestricted global type tokens.
No entry-motion or background-motion recipe is approved.

unresolvedClaims.impact: No source-faithful entry animation may be required, implemented as learned behavior, or visually accepted from the invalidated sequences.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Omit exact entry motion and do not use rejected or unstable frames for acceptance.

unresolvedClaims.impact: Translated stable screenshots cannot prescribe English line breaks.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Use pre-translation English DOM/computed typography with fluid wrapping.

unresolvedClaims.impact: Revision 2 does not release hover, click, or focus-state evidence beyond the visible CTA structure and typography.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Preserve a functional accessible action, but do not claim source-exact interaction styling without new Evidence.

requirementsForDesignDirection: Freeze the background and five foreground asset identities.
Require desktop copy-left/assets-right and mobile assets-first/copy-second.
Use pre-translation English DOM/computed typography and fluid wrapping.
Mark entry motion unresolved and prohibit exact implementation or acceptance from invalidated frames.
Reject solid-red fields, invented kickers, flattened screenshots, global token expansion, and background motion.
